title: Build Individual Vertical Detail Pages (/services/[id]) Across 6 Core Service Verticals Using PNG-Styled Spatial Canvas Architecture
description: Engineered and delivered the comprehensive suite of individual vertical detail pages (/services/[id]) for all 6 Core Service Verticals (Retail & Standard Framing, Bespoke Art & Custom Framing, Spatial Design & Signage, Industrial Fabrication & CNC Metalworks, Custom Gifting & Mementos, and Government & Civic Projects). Fully grounded in Frame Cottage's PNG-styled spatial canvas architecture with zero dense agentic text, dedicated dashed spatial containers (border-2 border-dashed border-[var(--color-border-strong)]/60 rounded-2xl bg-[var(--color-canvas-subtle)]/50) for transparent high-resolution PNG renders, Playfair Display serif headings, Geist sans UI labels, and #C5A059 gold accents across Museum Dark (#1A1A1A) and Warm Museum Light (#FAF8F5). Implemented static prerendering via generateStaticParams(), dynamic SEO metadata via generateMetadata(), interactive Quick Estimator Island with RFQ deep-linking, Technical Capabilities & Machinery Canvas, Material Specifications Matrix, 4-Stage Studio Execution Workflow, Client Case Studies, Technical FAQ, and Complementary Verticals Navigator.
acceptanceCriteria: Comprehensive service data model in data/services-data.ts and data/services/ covering all 6 verticals with audience badges, highlights, machinery capabilities, material tolerances, 4-stage workflows, pricing estimators, case studies, and FAQs
Dynamic page at app/services/[id]/page.tsx prerendering all 6 service verticals at build time with generateStaticParams() and generateMetadata()

Spatial Hero with breadcrumbs (Home / Services / [Vertical Name]), audience badge (B2C, B2B Commercial, Corporate, GeM Public Sector), dashed hero PNG canvas with depth shadow, and primary CTAs ('Initiate RFQ Specification' and 'Technical Spec Sheet')
Capabilities & Machinery Canvas with 4-6 cards featuring dashed drop zones for machine/sample PNG assets
Material Specifications Matrix table with verified tolerances, finishes, and archival standards
Interactive Quick Estimator Island allowing dynamic dimension and substrate tier selection, finishing addons, live price calculation, and direct pre-filled link to /rfq
Client Showcase & Case Studies Canvas with 16:9 full-bleed dashed project PNG containers and verified project metrics
4-Stage Studio Execution Workflow with step cards and dedicated dashed process diagram containers
Technical FAQ section with expandable dashed accordion items
Complementary Verticals navigation grid linking to adjacent service routes
Atelier Conversion Banner with direct deep-links into /rfq
Full dual-theme support across Museum Dark (#1A1A1A) and Warm Museum Light (#FAF8F5)
Mobile-responsive (390x844) with zero horizontal overflow (scrollWidth <= clientWidth)
Comprehensive Playwright test suite (tests/services-pages.spec.ts) covering all 6 routes (200 OK), navigation flow, estimator interactivity, mobile layout, theme toggle, and screenshot capture
Next.js Turbopack production build succeeds with 0 errors and generates 13/13 static routes
High-resolution screenshots captured in .agent/screenshots/ and brain directories for Desktop Dark, Desktop Light, and Mobile

steps.description: Construct Core Service Verticals Data Repository
steps.details: Created data/services/types.ts, data/services/index.ts, data/services-data.ts, and individual vertical datasets for retail-framing, bespoke-framing, spatial-signage, industrial-cnc, custom-gifting, and civic-projects.

steps.description: Build Spatial Hero & Key Highlights Strip
steps.details: Implemented components/services/service-hero.tsx with breadcrumb navigation, audience tag, dashed hero PNG canvas, and primary CTAs, along with components/services/service-highlights.tsx for trust indicators.
Implemented components/services/service-capabilities.tsx with 4-6 dashed cards featuring machine parameters, specifications, and dedicated sample PNG drop zones.
Implemented components/services/material-specs-matrix.tsx providing a clean, responsive specifications table with substrates, tolerances, and archival standards.
Implemented components/services/service-estimator.tsx ('use client') with dynamic dimension and material tier toggles, finishing options, real-time price calculation, and transfer to /rfq.

steps.description: Build Client Showcase & Case Studies Canvas
steps.details: Implemented components/services/service-case-studies.tsx with 16:9 dashed drop zone containers, verified project metrics, client names, and scope outcomes.

steps.description: Build 4-Stage Workflow, Technical FAQ & Related Verticals
Implement Dynamic Service Route & Index Redirect
steps.details: Implemented app/services/[id]/page.tsx with generateStaticParams() and generateMetadata(), plus app/services/page.tsx redirecting to /services/retail-framing.
Enhanced app/rfq/page.tsx with a Suspense-wrapped SearchParamsHandler that auto-selects the incoming service vertical and appropriate client tier.

steps.description: Develop and Execute Playwright Verification Suite & Capture Screenshots
steps.details: Authored tests/services-pages.spec.ts (11 tests). Verified all 6 routes render with 200 status, navigation from homepage to /services/spatial-signage to /rfq, zero mobile overflow (390x844), theme switching, and captured Desktop Dark, Desktop Light, and Mobile screenshots.
